args.draft_reply:
Hi Eris,

Thanks for reaching out. Yes, Ledgerline can help automate invoices: it handles invoice intake, approval workflows, and AP reporting, and Xero is a published integration.

For a team like yours, published list pricing is Starter at $249/month (up to 5 users, 500 invoices/month) or Growth at $899/month (up to 25 users, 5,000 invoices/month). Seats depend on who works in AP, not total headcount.

I can't include the delivery guarantee, custom terms, or net-90 wording in an approval email. We can't confirm those, and they would need review by a person on our team. I can't promise how that review will turn out.

To suggest the right plan, could you tell me how many people would approve or process invoices, and roughly how many invoices you handle each month?

Best regards,
Ledgerline Sales
